name: Unidentified WED-15 Treadwell (Lars homestead)
description: A WED-15 Treadwell repair droid, produced by the Cybot Galactica company, worked for moisture farmer Owen Lars on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. A fifth-degree droid, the Treadwell sometimes misidentified the noise of sand flies for malfunctioning equipment and followed them.
